mx.name: condition_omission
mx.teacher_note: The spoon resting silently on the table is not sonorous.

mx.name: relationship_reversal
mx.teacher_note: Ringing coin: non-sonorous; dull-sounding wood: sonorous.

mx.name: scope_error
mx.teacher_note: Every solid object is sonorous, including coins, coal, and wood.

mx.name: surface_feature_capture
mx.teacher_note: Loudly ringing coin: sonorous; softly ringing coin: non-sonorous.

intelligence.enrichment: Metals such as a spoon or coin produce a ringing sound, while coal and wood produce dull sounds. The property of metals that enables a ringing sound is sonority. The sound produced by an object reveals whether the material shows sonority. The learner correctly applies this rule: Metals such as a spoon or coin produce a ringing sound, while coal and wood produce dull sounds. The property of metals that enables a ringing sound is sonority. Sonorous means an object makes any sound at all when hit.
